semiconductor_relevance: Low — Sapporo City is primarily a governmental entity promoting business development rather than a semiconductor supplier.
summary: Sapporo City is focused on attracting businesses to the region by offering subsidies and promoting its favorable business and living environment. The city is also establishing a design, research, and development base for semiconductors and related electronic components as part of its redevelopment efforts.
capabilities: Promotion of a decarbonized society through renewable energy

regional_presence.Japan: Sapporo City is actively promoting its business environment and redevelopment initiatives to attract semiconductor-related investments.
